summary: Boy aged 7 beaten by stepfather with a hose, bruised; mother afraid to report.
text: KPAI please help. My neighbour's 7-year-old is often beaten with a hose by his stepfather, his body is covered in bruises. Last night he was screaming again. His mother is afraid to report it. We are in Bekasi.

summary: Several students say a teacher at a boarding school molested them; parents want protection.
text: Dear KPAI, I am the parent of a student at a boarding school in Garut. My child and several friends say one of the teachers molested them. We are afraid other children are still there. Please protect them.

summary: Girl aged 16 recruited for a job in Batam, now held and not allowed to contact family.
text: Please help KPAI, my 16-year-old sister was taken to Batam for a job as a café waitress. Now her phone has been taken; she only managed to message that she is locked in and forced to serve guests.

summary: Girl aged 14 threatened by an online contact to spread her photos unless she sends more.
text: @KPAI_official please help, my 14-year-old is being threatened by someone she met in an online game, who says he will spread her photos unless she sends more. What should we do?

summary: Video of a student being bullied is spreading on social media; parents ask for it to be taken down.
text: Dear KPAI, a video of my child being bullied by classmates at school was posted on TikTok and has thousands of views. My child refuses to go to school. Please help get the video taken down.

summary: Mother says ex-husband has stopped child support ordered by the court after divorce.
text: Dear KPAI, my ex-husband has not paid the child support ordered by the religious court for 8 months. I have two children aged 5 and 9.

summary: Father denied access to his children by ex-wife after divorce; asks for mediation.
text: I am the father of two children. Since the divorce a year ago I have not been allowed to see them. I ask KPAI to mediate so the children's right to see their father is respected.

summary: Toddler left alone for days by parents working abroad; grandmother too ill to care.
text: In my village a 3-year-old has been left with a sick grandmother while the parents work abroad. The child often goes without food and plays alone in the street.

summary: Couple asks about the legal process to adopt a relative's child.
text: Dear KPAI, we would like to adopt a relative's child. What is the correct legal procedure so the child's rights are protected?

summary: School withholds a child's report card over unpaid fees.
text: Dear KPAI, my child's school is withholding the report card because we are 3 months behind on fees. My child is ashamed and doesn't want to go to school. Is a school allowed to do this?

summary: Student badly injured in a senior-junior hazing ritual during school orientation.
text: @KPAI_official my son in grade 10 was beaten by senior students during school orientation and needed stitches in his head. The school says it is a tradition. Please act.

summary: Child with disability refused enrolment at the local primary school.
text: My child is deaf and was refused at the state primary school near our home because there is no special-needs teacher. What about my child's right to education?

summary: Dozens of pupils vomiting and dizzy after the free school meal at SDN Cempaka 2; some taken to the health centre.
text: KPAI please help, at SDN Cempaka 2 dozens of children are vomiting and dizzy after today's free school lunch (MBG). Some were taken to the health centre on teachers' motorbikes. My child is one of them.

summary: Parent says the free meal at SDN Cempaka 2 smelled spoiled for the third time this month.
text: Dear KPAI, the free school meals (MBG) at SDN Cempaka 2 have been spoiled and smelly three times this month. My child has stomach aches. Please supervise the food supplier.

summary: More pupils at SDN Cempaka 2 ill after school meals; parents ask who checks the kitchen.
text: @KPAI_official another poisoning at SDN Cempaka 2, the second time. Who checks the free-meal kitchen? The children are now afraid to eat.

summary: School committee requests an inspection of the free-meal supplier serving SDN Cempaka 2.
text: Dear KPAI, the school committee of SDN Cempaka 2 asks KPAI to oversee the free-meal (MBG) supplier after several cases of children falling ill at our school.

summary: Pupils at a neighbouring school served by the same kitchen also had stomach aches.
text: At SDN Cempaka 1, served by the same kitchen, children also had stomach aches after the free meal. Please check it as well.

summary: Boy aged 15 detained by police for a street fight without a lawyer or parents present.
text: Dear KPAI, my 15-year-old son was detained at the police station for a street fight. He was questioned without a lawyer or a parent. Is this in line with the juvenile justice rules?

summary: Mother asks about diversion for her son accused of theft.
text: My 14-year-old son is accused of stealing a friend's phone. The police said diversion is possible. What is it and how does it work?

summary: Young children forced to beg at traffic lights late at night by an adult.
text: @KPAI_official every night at the Grogol traffic lights small children are made to beg until 1 am, with an adult watching them and taking the money.

summary: Mother says the police case of her daughter's sexual abuse has stalled for 6 months; asks KPAI oversight.
text: Dear KPAI, I reported the sexual abuse of my daughter to the city police 6 months ago but nothing has happened and the abuser is still free. Please oversee this case.

summary: Child cannot get a birth certificate because the parents' marriage is unregistered.
text: Dear KPAI, my child cannot get a birth certificate because our marriage is not registered, so registering for school is difficult. What can we do?

summary: Asks about KPAI office hours and how to file a complaint in person.
text: Good afternoon, on which days can complaints be made in person at the KPAI office? Which documents should I bring?

summary: CCTV shows a daycare worker hitting toddlers; parents ask for action.
text: KPAI, CCTV footage from my child's daycare shows the carer hitting and pinching several toddlers. The daycare owner is covering it up. Where should we report?
